meta.description: FCP/LCP for a text-LCP page with its CSS inlined (<style>), linked (<link>), or inlined plus duplicated at the end of the body (as Next.js inlineCss does via the RSC payload). Medians and quartiles per cell; 'cold' = fresh browser context, 'repeat' = same URL loaded again in the same context.
meta.method: Headless Chrome, DevTools network throttling (request-level latency) and CPU throttling. Local server, brotli quality 11. HTML Cache-Control: no-store; CSS: immutable.
